posts.text: This thread highlights the importance of activists like Icahn, Ackman and Paul Singer. While I haven’t found anything in their financial statement that constitutes a “fraud”, I think their disclosures to minority shareholders should be lot better. Major concerns for me: 1) the proposed 500 cr loan arrangement to a company Kiri Industries owns only 48% of: Kiri Infrastructure. They’re basically giving a company with 27 cr net worth + 0 revenue An unsecured loan of 500 cr, AT 7%. Just 7. This to me is not fair. posts.text: Financial Closure has not been achieved yet. The promoters have had a habit of over promising and missing deadlines (but not sharing the true timelines with the minority shareholders). Keeping in mind that eventually and each time they’ve managed to achieve their goals & targets, is this still a big Red Flag, as inability to secure the debt funding can really mess up the things this time?
